ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a bar chart of the input proportions of three types of factories, Jia, Yi, and Bing, in items such as wages, fuel, raw materials, transportation costs, science and technology, and others, with the vertical axis being the input composition proportion. The legend shows that Jia is the black bar. Observing the black bars of the Jia-type factory, among all input items, the "raw materials" bar is the highest, obviously higher than wages, fuel, transportation costs, science and technology, and others. Then reason: When divided by industrial dominant factor, whichever input item has the highest proportion usually indicates that the industry is most affected by that factor. The Jia-type factory has the highest proportion of raw material input; therefore, its dominant factor is raw materials, and the industrial type it represents is raw-material-oriented.
